scope: One complete frozen consumer artifact reconstruction; no model fitting, prediction, scoring, labels, held-set inference, source edits, or protocol relaxation.
hypothesis: The current non-exact intermediate support NPZ inputs can still reproduce the exact frozen consumer float32 waveforms and bool admissibility files after the unchanged native acquisition and normalization path is run.

unit.acceptance: Both artifact hashes must match exactly; any one-file mismatch is failure. No approximate, scalar, per-design, or numerical acceptance.

source_contract.contract_call: experiment_support_modal_v2.contract() must pass before native raw acquisition; all declared source input and implementation hashes remain enforced.
source_contract.native_source_manifest_call: raw_modal_data._source_manifest() remains reachable through acquire() and load_measured(); controller does not replace it or disable hash validation.
source_contract.normalization: experiment_support_modal_v2.noise_for and experiment_support_modal_v2.M.normalize are called only by unchanged raw_modal_data.acquire().

controller.execution_mode: dispatcher-owned explicit --execute; this PREPARE phase does not launch it
controller.receipt: controller_receipt.json (created only by an execution, never copied from old evidence)
controller.recording: The child process records the effective module constants and thread environment in artifact/controller_context.json before acquisition; the parent records its hash and all actual output/source hashes in controller_receipt.json.

execution.requested_work: contract, native raw acquisition, read-only native load/shape checks, exact SHA comparison
forbidden_work: writes outside the new output namespace and receipt
prelaunch_guards: every required source file and all 20 source shards must exist and match source_manifest.json
D000007 must match its exact frozen SHA and size
D000152 must match only the explicitly recorded current intermediate SHA and size; its original NPZ SHA is not required and is not claimed
artifact/ and controller_receipt.json must be absent; no overwrite or retry is permitted
stop_rules: contract or native physical/source validation failure
execution.on_mismatch: Preserve the new artifact and truthful receipt/context as a separate lineage; stop immediately, do not retag, recompress, overwrite, retry, or claim original support-NPZ restoration.
execution.on_success: Freeze the new artifact and receipt; this does not promote a P4 gate or establish original NPZ identity.

time_observations.interpretation: These are prior support-stage observations only, not a measured consumer reconstruction runtime; the single 600-second acquisition deadline is the hard bound.

remote_inventory.mode: one bounded BatchMode SSH read-only check
unavailable_at_prepare: support_modal_20261009_v2/dataset.npz was absent in the checked recovery root
raw_modal_20261010 consumer outputs were absent in the checked recovery root
remote_inventory.meaning: Inventory is evidence only; no transfer, acquisition, unit launch, or remote write was performed.

nonclaims: A matching consumer artifact would not prove the intermediate D000152 NPZ is byte-identical to the original.
A matching consumer artifact would not restore or alter any source, old evidence, P4_PROGRESS.json, gate, label, or model result.
No execution, output hash, or physical validation result exists in PREPARE_ONLY phase.
